title: StereoEngine: Scaling Stereo Bimanual Robot Data without Stereo Cameras
abstract: arXiv:2610.12734v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Stereo vision is increasingly used for robotic manipulation, with a growing body of work incorporating it into Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models. However, the scarcity of large-scale, real-world stereo datasets remains a fundamental bottleneck for scaling such policies. Recent generative monocular-to-stereo methods target settings such as VR content and autonomous driving. No prior work produces realistic synthetic stereo data for robotic manipulation, where stereo supervision has come predominantly from simulation. We propose StereoEngine, which introduces two complementary methods to synthesize stereo data for robotic manipulation. In the first, we warp a monocular (left) video into the right view using estimated depth and inpaint the disoccluded regions with a video diffusion model, lifting monocular demonstrations into stereo pairs without training on real stereo. translated_title: StereoEngine：无需立体相机即可扩展立体双手机器人数据
translated_abstract: 双目立体视觉在机器人操作中的应用日益增多，越来越多的研究将其融入视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型中。然而，大规模真实世界立体数据集的稀缺仍然是扩展此类策略的根本瓶颈。近期的生成式单目转立体方法主要面向VR内容和自动驾驶等场景，此前尚无工作能够为机器人操作生成逼真的合成立体数据，而该领域的立体监督信号主要来自仿真。我们提出StereoEngine，引入两种互补的方法为机器人操作合成立体数据。在第一种方法中，我们利用估计的深度将单目（左目）视频重投影（warp）到右目视角，并使用视频扩散模型对去遮挡（disoccluded）区域进行修复补全，从而无需在真实立体数据上训练即可将单目演示提升为立体视频对。在第二种方法中，我们在仿真中渲染立体视频对，并联合……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: StereoEngine通过“深度估计+重投影与视频扩散模型补全将单目演示提升为立体视频对”和“仿真立体渲染联合训练”两种互补方法合成逼真的机器人操作立体数据，无需立体相机即可大规模扩展双手机器人立体数据集。
en_tdlr: StereoEngine synthesizes realistic stereo data for robotic manipulation through two complementary methods—lifting monocular demonstrations into stereo pairs via depth-based warping with video diffusion inpainting, and simulation-based stereo rendering—enabling large-scale stereo bimanual robot data collection without stereo cameras.
